title: (Pwn2Own) Sonos One Speaker libsmb2 Integer Overflow Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Sonos One Speaker. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of the SMB directory query command. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in an integer overflow before reading from memory. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of root.
